:::{#exr-left-null-space-practice}
#### Testing whether a vector is in a left null space

The [left null space](#def-left-null-space) of a [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$
is the [null space](#def-null-space) of its [transpose](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-transpose).
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4}
$$

and let $\vecf{y}$ be the [column vector](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-column-vector) $(2, -1)$.

Decide whether $\vecf{y}$ is in $\mathcal{N}(\tp{\matr{A}})$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Compute $\tp{\matr{A}}\vecf{y}$.

:::

:::
